text:
Beautiful river! In your clear and shining wave

of crystal, wandering water, you are an emblem

of beauty's splendor, an emblem of the heart

that does not hide itself now, an emblem

of art's joyful fantasy in the house of old

Albert's daughter.


--


But while she gazes into your current,-which

shines and trembles, why does the most

beautiful of all rivers remind one of its

worshipers? It is because in her heart, as in

your wave, her image is deeply engraved;

in her heart that trembles beneath the brightness of

her soul-searching eyes!

translation.title: To the River
translation.editorial_note: The translation follows the Spanish Poe text's emblematic river and its reflection of the beloved.
